_note: 科研時事（站點級，跨科目）。顯示在三科總覽頁。cat 用 bio/chem/phys/math，只影響標籤顏色。越新的排越前。內容必須來自可靠來源並附連結——時事不是常識，寧可少寫也不要編。每天從泛科學、ScienceDaily、Nature 主刊精選 8 篇（單一來源最多 3 篇、單一科目最多 3 篇），本檔由 scripts/fetch_news.py 自動產生，可手動補充。

items.t: 關於光的數十年之謎可能是更快網路的關鍵
items.x: 一種用於超高速光通訊的有前途的材料幾十年來一直是個秘密，但科學家可能最終破解了它。韓國科學技術院和加州理工學院的研究人員精確測量了鈦酸鋇如何控制和吸收光，解決了長期以來阻礙其發展的不確定性。他們的發現可以使製造快速傳輸資訊的光學設備變得更加容易
items.orig: A decades-old mystery about light could hold the key to faster internet
items.origX: A promising material for ultra-fast optical communications has held a secret for decades, but scientists may have finally cracked it. Researchers at KAIST and Caltech have precisely measured how barium titanate controls and absorbs light, resolving longstanding uncertainties that have slowed its development. Their findings could make it easier to build optical devices that transmit information faster while wasting less light.

items.t: 克勞德，為我找一顆行星：業餘天文學家正在使用人工智慧，結果好壞參半

items.origX: Artificial-intelligence tools are helping citizen scientists to identify previously unknown exoplanet candidates — some more credible than others.

items.t: 角膜太薄無法近視雷射？眼科醫師解析「植入式隱形眼鏡」EVO ICL，保留角膜且可隨時取出！
items.x: 高度近視或角膜太薄無法做近視雷射嗎？「EVO ICL植入式隱形眼鏡」保留完整角膜結構，不僅能降低術後乾眼風險，晶體更具備可取出的彈性，是視力矯正的安全新選擇。

items.t: 為什麼氫火焰會發出橙色光，然後幾乎看不見
items.x: 氫火焰可以從亮橙色轉變為幾乎看不見，這取決於一些意想不到的情況：空氣中漂浮著微量的鈉。科學家表示，這項發現可以透過用專門的感測器取代視覺火焰檢測來幫助未來的氫動力爐和烤箱更安全。
items.orig: Why hydrogen flames can glow orange, then turn nearly invisible
items.origX: Hydrogen flames can shift from bright orange to nearly invisible depending on something unexpected: tiny amounts of sodium floating in the air. Scientists say this discovery could help make future hydrogen-powered stoves and ovens safer by replacing visual flame detection with specialized sensors.

items.t: 一年吞下5億顆安眠藥！大腦當機睡不著？新型藥物與 CBT-I 帶你找回「關機力」
items.x: 台灣人一年吃掉超過 5 億顆安眠藥，平均一天吞下 138 萬顆！難道我們真的這麼難入睡嗎？面對漫漫長夜，許多人依賴藥物來強制大腦關機，但安眠藥吃久了怕成癮、擔心戒不掉，甚至憂慮會引發失智。到底失眠一定要吃藥嗎？吃了十年的藥還有機會戒除嗎？這一集，就讓挺健康鄭丁…

items.t: 已有 50 年歷史的進化論可能一直都是錯的
items.x: 幾十年前的理論認為演化可以保護其最重要的基因免受突變，但這一理論受到了重大打擊。對細菌和酵母突變的廣泛新分析發現，沒有證據表明必需基因的突變頻率低於其他基因。研究人員表示，早期的研究可能被有害突變誤導，這些突變在科學家之前就已經透過自然選擇消失了
items.orig: A 50-year-old theory about evolution may have been wrong all along
items.origX: A decades-old theory suggesting that evolution protects its most important genes from mutations has been dealt a major blow. An extensive new analysis of mutations in bacteria and yeast found no evidence that essential genes mutate less frequently than other genes. Researchers say earlier studies may have been misled by harmful mutations that disappeared through natural selection before scientists could detect them.

items.x: 眾所周知，挑戰合成和永續製造現有邊界的新催化歧管很難實施1，特別是對於基於金屬的催化範例，這些範例缺乏支持許多已建立的 d 區機械途徑（例如氧化加成和還原消除）的基本過程。系統基礎的廣泛利用
items.origX: New catalytic manifolds that challenge existing boundaries for synthesis and sustainable manufacturing are notoriously difficult to implement1, particularly for catalytic paradigms based on metals which lack access to the fundamental processes that underpin many established d-block mechanistic pathways (e.g. oxidative addition and reductive elimination). The widespread exploitation of systems based on main-group elements therefore requires alternative elementary steps to effect turnover. Herein, we demonstrate a new catalytic platform for nucleophilic fluorination, which exploits a complex based on calcium (the fifth most Earth-abundant element) as the fluoride delivery vehicle. The key intermediate is a calcium-fluoride complex featuring a terminal Ca–F interaction, a unique structural geometry enabled by a highly sterically encumbered dianionic ligand-scaffold. This intermediate links reactants and products through F– capture and release steps, and thereby unlocks catalytic F– shuttling. Late Ca–F bond breaking in the rate-determining fluoride-delivery transition-state means that electronic and steric tuning of F– by calcium is chemically significant; proof-of-concept results show a hitherto unprecedented level of selectivity for substitution over elimination brought about by Ca-modulation. In a broader context, this work demonstrates how control over catalyst speciation and reagent binding affinity are key factors for the future development of sustainable non-transition metal paradigms in catalysis.
